text:
Priya M: Morning folks  I just noticed my benefits portal says 'No coverage' even though I enrolled during onboarding. Started last Thursday (India-based). Did I miss a step? I attached passport + visa docs as `priya_pass.pdf`. Also my meal stipend hasn't posted to the card.

Maya (People Ops): Hi Priya! Welcome. Sometimes international enrollments require manual audit. I'll check Workday. @Alex (Benefits) can you confirm enrollment?

Alex (Benefits): Looking now. It shows 'pending audit' because we need domestic address verification and KYC for the stipend. Priya, can you confirm local address and upload a recent utility bill to the portal under 'proof_of_address'?

Priya M: Just uploaded `priya_utility.jpg`. Meal stipend also says 'pending' on the card portal.

Ben - Payroll: For India payroll we use local INR payroll; timing depends on local cutoffs. Meal stipends are loaded monthly on the 1st after the finance close. If you're missing it, I'll queue a card load exception. Priya, what's your employee ID?

Priya M: ID 3849. Thanks.

Maya (People Ops): Got it. Alex I've flagged the enrollment and asked for audit priority. Ben I'll DM the ID for the stipend exception.

Alex (Benefits): Enrollment confirmed after audit. Coverage effective from the 1st of next month post 30-day waiting period. You'll get confirmation email with plan docs.

Ben - Payroll: Stipend exception queued for today. Expect card load in 24 hours. If it doesn't appear, reply here and I'll escalate.

Priya M: Thanks all one. Quick tax Q: I saw a local tax form in Workday for India employees  do I need to fill that to get correct withholding?

Maya (People Ops): Yes please complete the local withholding form (Form IT-1) in Workday within 7 days. If not filled we'll apply default withholding.

Priya M: Done. Appreciate the super fast help :)
